xna-type.name: OpaqueDataDictionary
xna-type.summary: Provides properties that define opaque data for a game asset.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of OpaqueDataDictionary.

method.name: GetContentAsXml
method.summary: Gets the data contents and returns it as a single XML string. This format is useful for doing deep equality comparison or object hashing.

overload.summary: Gets the data contents and returns it as a single XML string. This format is useful for doing deep equality comparison or object hashing.

method.name: GetValue
method.summary: Gets the value of the specified key/value pair of the asset.

overload.summary: Gets the value of the specified key/value pair of the asset.

parameters.parameter: The value to return if the key cannot be found. This can be null for reference types, 0 for primitive types, and a zero-filled structure for structure types.

overload.returns: The value of the retrieved opaque data.
overload.remarks: GetValue looks only for values of a specific type. If the entry is of a different type, the defaultvalue is returned.
